candidates.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by Amon-Ra St. Brown during the New England vs Detroit Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.0025 per receiving yard constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 400 yards. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Payouts are proportional to the size of the holder's position. For example, 80 receiving yards pays Yes $0.20 and No $0.80; 200 yards pays Yes $0.50 and No $0.50; zero yards pay Yes $0.00 and No $1.00.

candidates.title: Deshaun Watson: 200+ passing yards (Protected)
candidates.rules_primary: If Deshaun Watson records 200+ passing yards in the Houston vs Cleveland Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This Contract is designated as protected. If the individual player participates in at least one play during the first half of the game but does not participate in any play after the conclusion of the first half, including any overtime period, this Contract resolves to the fair price prior to the opening kickoff of the game unless the player records the required number of passing yards, in which case this Contract settles based on actual statistics. If the player participates in at least one play after the conclusion of the first half, this Contract settles based on actual statistics, regardless of first-half participation. Injury, an injury designation, or being ruled out is not required for protection.

Participation in a play nullified by penalty counts. Lining up for a play stopped by a penalty before the snap, without participating in a subsequent play, does not count. A player who never participates remains subject to the fair price non-participation rule. The protected designation applies only to full-game contracts with an above or at-least payout criterion. This event uses at least full game passing yards including overtime.
